I need to analyze whether the implementation correctly calculates the number of collisions between two sets of n cars moving in opposite directions.

Let me think through the problem:
- n cars moving left to right
- n cars moving right to left
- All cars move at the same speed
- Cars pass through each other when they collide
- Need to count total collisions

Since all cars move at the same speed and the two groups start far apart and move toward each other:
- Each car moving left to right will eventually meet each car moving right to left
- Since cars pass through each other, every left-to-right car will collide with every right-to-left car exactly once
- This gives us n × n = n² total collisions

Let me verify with examples:
- n=1: 1 car going left-to-right, 1 car going right-to-left → 1 collision ✓
- n=2: 2 cars going left-to-right, 2 cars going right-to-left → each of the 2 left-to-right cars collides with each of the 2 right-to-left cars → 4 collisions ✓
- n=3: 3×3 = 9 collisions ✓
